reviews.title: Crazy indeed
reviews.text: I am leaving this review before deleting the game. The economy of this game is seriously terrible and one of the worst of any games I’ve played. You can buy 30B coins for $100, but progressing in a minor way in the game costs in the TRILLIONS. You use 150K spins to reach a goal and get 50 spins back. It’s basically a slot machine game where they control the outcome of the spins and thus you reaching goals. It is not skill-based at all. You will get really close to a goal and then spend thousands of useless spins to prevent you from reaching the next goal and then the pop ups to purchase start where you get VERY little back for a lot of money. Don’t be manipulated by this game.
